note: RC16 validation-only split-control R3-12 regression. The harness consumes the previously audited R2-05 reboot checkpoint/evidence, re-verifies DUT_REBOOT facts from its immutable manifest, requires the device to remain on the proven post-reboot boot_id, then runs a deterministic real 24-byte Segment through production Sealer/SCP/durable/ACK/delete on that post-reboot boot. This avoids an extra APF1250 reboot while preserving auditable reboot + data-plane continuity proof. Capture Engine runtime remains unchanged; Production V2 stays disabled.
